S110.02.needs: a chat that produced a presentation or a file, or a request for a presentation
S110.02.note: Presentation (pptx) support is in apps/mobile/src/features/chat/utils/generatedFileArtifacts.ts and GeneratedFileCard.tsx; the visible name of the output-format option in the + sheet was not located, so the exact creation step is unverified.
steps: Open a chat that has a generated file or artifact card.
Tap the artifact card to open the artifact screen.
Look for the file card showing the file name, kind and checksum.
Tap Share generated file (or Download artifact) to keep a copy.
Compare with Expected: a presentation opens or can be shared and kept.
S110.02.where: Chat > open a chat artifact card > Share generated file (the presentation is requested from the + (Add to chat) sheet, where the output format option is; its visible label was not found)

S110.03.needs: a spreadsheet file and a web account with E2B execution enabled
S110.03.note: Chart artifacts open on the phone in the artifact screen (testID artifact-fullscreen-chart at apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/ArtifactFullScreen.tsx:1886, not visible text). The chart-in-report step is web-side: apps/web/lib/e2b/gate.ts gates on AGI_E2B_EXECUTION=1 and E2B_API_KEY. No mobile control that builds the report with a chart was found, and the spreadsheet upload control was not located.

S110.07.needs: a microphone, a signed-in cloud account, and AGI Work available on the account
S110.07.note: The voice tool agi_work (packages/contracts/cloud-contracts/src/live-voice-tools.ts) only starts the task when the chat can request AGI Work (canUseAgiWork); the plan that grants it was not confirmed.
steps: Open a chat and tap the Start voice mode button in the composer.
Tap Start voice (or pick a voice first) and allow the microphone.
Say a task, for example a request that needs several steps and tools.
Watch for the Work mode message the phone sends into the chat, then open the side menu and tap AGI Work.
Compare with Expected: the request appears as a task in AGI Work without retyping it.
S110.07.where: Chat screen > Start voice mode (microphone button in the composer) > Start voice > speak the request > Work switch (Work) > AGI Work list in the side menu

S110.18.needs: a web account and the same account signed in on the phone, with network access
S110.18.note: The cloud header label comes from a constant (PRIVACY_MODE_DISPLAY.managed.label) in apps/mobile/src/features/chat/ChatsListScreen.tsx, and the side-menu open control and New chat key were not located. The label above appears only for untitled chats.
steps: Sign in with the same account on the web app and start a chat there.
On the phone, open the side menu and check the chat list in cloud mode.
Open the web conversation and confirm the full earlier history is shown.
Send a follow-up message on the phone.
Open the web app again and check the reply appears in the same conversation (compare with Expected).
S110.18.where: Side menu > chat list (cloud mode) > the conversation title

S110.21.needs: a paired and connected desktop computer, a signed-in account, and Remote Control on the plan
S110.21.note: The send control's visible label was not found and the desktop's approval rules are applied on the computer; the settings page says Remote Control comes with paid plans (apps/mobile/app/(app)/settings/remote-control.tsx).
steps: Make sure a computer is paired and connected (Settings > Remote control > Connections).
Open the side menu and tap AGI Code, then open the paired computer.
In the Start on Desktop box, type a request in the field that says What should Desktop work on?.
Tap the send control and wait.
Look under Recent Dispatch tasks for the task and expand its result to check it matches Expected.
S110.21.where: Side menu > AGI Code (or Settings > Remote control > Connections) > the paired computer > Start on Desktop

S110.24.needs: an existing project with sources or instructions
S110.24.note: The Projects side-menu label is a translation key (navProjects) whose text was not found, and the grounding of answers in project sources was not traced to a visible control.
steps: Create or open a project under Projects in the side menu and add a source or instruction.
Open a new chat and tap the + (Add to chat) button in the composer.
Tap Project and choose the project; the row shows its name in place of Choose.
Ask a question that the project's sources should answer.
Compare the answer with the project's sources and instructions (Expected).
S110.24.where: Chat > + (Add to chat) > Project (shows Choose or the project name)

S110.26.needs: a Free account or an account at its usage limit
S110.26.note: Which option appears depends on the server's quota error code (classifyManagedQuotaErrorCode in apps/mobile/app/(app)/chat/[id].tsx); the reset-time wording was not checked, and purchase options vary by platform.
steps: Send a message on an account that has reached its usage limit.
Read the sheet: it names the blocked feature and the reset time if one applies.
If offered, tap Choose a standard model to continue with a standard model in one step.
Otherwise tap View upgrade options (or Choose a plan) and check the plan options shown.
Compare with Expected: an eligible alternative is offered and can be taken in one step.
S110.26.where: Chat > send a message when usage is used up > paywall sheet > Choose a standard model or View upgrade options

S110.28.needs: a signed-in cloud account and an artifact that can be published
S110.28.note: Edit source is shown only when the artifact can be edited; Restore version is an accessibility label built from a template in ArtifactFullScreen.tsx, and the version history sheet is apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/ArtifactVersionHistorySheet.tsx.
steps: Open a chat artifact and tap More artifact actions, then Publish artifact to a public link and confirm Publish.
Tap Edit source, change the text, and tap Save as a new version.
Tap More artifact actions again and tap Republish artifact link; confirm the same link updates.
Tap Show changes and use the version counter (Previous version / Next version) to compare versions.
Tap Restore version to go back to an earlier version, then check the link and version history (Expected).
S110.28.where: Open a chat artifact > More artifact actions > Republish artifact link (or Publish artifact to a public link) > Edit source > Save as a new version > Version N of M > Restore version N
